name: West Warwick Civic Center Summer Program
operator_name: West Warwick Civic Center (Town of West Warwick)
description_short: A town-run summer day program at the Thomas A. Lamb Field House in West Warwick, June 16 - August 14, 2026, weekdays 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Early drop-off from 7:30 AM and late pick-up to 3:30 PM are available for an extra fee. Paid by the week, with early-bird discounts for paying in full.
